_comment: Generic MCP server template for the omnissiah framework. Add the servers your project needs under 'mcpServers'. Each entry follows the shape shown in '_example' below. No hosts, credentials, or paths are filled in by default.

setup_instructions: 1. Add your servers under 'mcpServers' (remove the empty object).
2. Use the '_example' block above as a template for each entry.
3. Reference secrets via environment variables, e.g. "${SOME_API_TOKEN}", never hardcode them.
4. Copy this file or merge it into ~/.claude/settings.json under 'mcpServers'.
_documentation.adding_servers: Add entries under 'mcpServers' and run 'node install.js --force' to merge into user settings.
_documentation.windows_note: On Windows, ${HOME} in env values is resolved to the actual home directory at install time. Run 'node install.js --force' to re-apply after cloning on Windows.
